result:
I applied D-202 option (a) to the A17 failing-connector test, but the scenario still fails, on a product defect I'm reporting as **QA-A2-F1 (proposed High, mandatory violation)**. Following the assignment, I kept the failing test and did not work around it. So acceptance items 1 and 2 are not met; items 3, 5 and 6 are met, and item 4 (the requirement → test table) is in the handback.

**The defect.** As decided, the admin now sees only the count, and the transformation's KDS and auditor read the linked KPI. The admin part passes: `linkedKpiCount 1, hiddenKpiCount 1, linkedKpis []`. But KDS and auditor get the KPI back as `freshness "unknown"`, `lastValue null`, `lastValueAt null`. Its last accepted value is 250.75 as of 2026-01-31, and the KPI panel itself correctly shows it as Stale. The exception detail only looks at the organization's newest reporting period. So once a later period is open, the last known value is lost, and that is exactly the situation when a connector fails in real use. BE-X2's earlier probe missed this because it ran the scenario alone, when 2026-01 was the only period. The scenario now opens its own later period, so it fails the same way alone, in the file and in the full suite. The UI shows the same thing in English and Arabic: the data owner sees "Unknown" for freshness, value and date.

This may need an architect ruling, not just a fix. The product code says it mirrors the KPI panel's current period, while ADR-0053 §2 and the API contract promise the last known value.

**What I wrote** (uncommitted):
- `tests/qa/integration/a17-import-and-integration.test.ts`: only the failing-connector test changed. It now covers the admin count, the KDS and auditor reads, and a check that a user from another organization is refused.
- `e2e/a17-failing-connector-exception.spec.ts` (new): the data owner's and the admin's views of the exception page, on the real stack with the production worker, in English and Arabic.

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| DG5 historical validation, start and end | 0 / 0 | PASS |
| A17 integration file, final content | 1 | 9 passed, 1 failed (QA-A2-F1 only) |
| Full `tests/qa` integration suite | 1 | 41 of 42 files pass; 402 of 403 tests pass; the 1 failure is QA-A2-F1 |
| Root A17 e2e, English and Arabic, one worker | 1 | 10 passed, 2 failed (my new spec in both languages, only the last-value assertions) |
| `pnpm lint` | 0 | clean |
| Prettier, whole tree | 0 | clean |
| Typecheck of my two files | 2 | 0 errors in my files; 1 error in product file `preview.ts` that the previous QA author's log already shows |
| Mutation checks (5) | — | all 5 killed |

In the failing e2e runs, everything except the last-value assertions passed: page language and direction, axe with 0 serious or critical issues, the admin seeing only the count, and no KPI data changing. None of the runs hit a timeout.

**Mutation checks.** I ran them in a throwaway copy of the code in my temp folder, never in the working tree. First I applied a temporary repair that keeps the last known value, and with it the test passes. On top of that, each of these 5 deliberate breaks made the test fail as it should: the admin seeing the hidden KPI, the data owner being denied, the freshness forced to "fresh", the value zeroed, and the date shifted by a day.

**Run disclosures:**
- The first run failed at startup because `node_modules` is read-only here. I re-ran with `--configLoader runner`, as the previous QA author did.
- My first full-suite start died within seconds because of a backgrounding mistake on my part. I discarded its log and re-ran it cleanly.
- One early log of the A17 file was overwritten; a later log records the same result.
- Several runs used the test file before a formatting pass and a comment rewording. Neither changes behaviour, and the final-content run above confirms the result.

**Observation O1 (proposed Low, not asserted by my tests):** in Arabic, the exception page shows the error message in English ("The source system did not respond."), and its full stop lands at the wrong end of the line.

**Still open:**
- QA-A2-F1 needs a product fix or an ADR ruling; after that, re-running the A17 file and my e2e spec should need no test change.
- The root e2e doesn't check that connector retries and row counts are visible in the UI (part of REQ-S17-001; outside this assignment).
- REQ-DLV-038 is an aggregate row this task doesn't cover.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/T-DG6-QA-A2-authoring/`; open `handback.md` first.
